Entra para gestionar tus servidores de M: Sign in to manage your Minecraft servers.

El idioma, el tema, los sonidos y los lo: Language, theme, sounds and achievements are saved in this browser.

Para quien no ha elegido otro en Aparien: For anyone who hasn't picked another one in Appearance.

El servidor solo acepta conexiones de tu: The server only accepts connections from your local network
Escribe un comando: say Hola, list, whit: Type a command: say Hello, list, whitelist add Alex…
Los cambios se aplican a <strong>todos l: Changes apply to every modpack automatically. If the server is running, use the console commands so they take effect right away.
Los cambios requieren reinicio del servi: Changes need a server restart to apply. Unrecognised properties appear in the advanced editor at the end.
Puede ser una carpeta de mundo comprimid: It can be a compressed world folder or a zip with the folder inside.
Si el servidor está en marcha, detenlo a: If the server is running, stop it before activating the uploaded world.
El mundo se genera al iniciar el servido: The world is generated when the server starts. If it's running, stop it first.
Límite paquetes/jugador (0 = sin límite): Packet limit per player (0 = no limit)
RCON se activa y configura automáticamen: RCON is enabled and configured automatically when the server starts (needed to refresh metrics without flooding the console), so it doesn't appear here.
Propiedades no reconocidas por el formul: Properties the form doesn't recognise. Edit with care.
Cada modpack guarda la RAM en un sitio d: Each modpack stores its RAM in a different place depending on how it was installed (user_jvm_args.txt, variables.txt, or inside its own start script) — the panel detects which one this one uses before letting you change anything. Changes need a server restart to apply.
Configuración de los mods instalados. Lo: Settings of the installed mods. Changes apply when the server restarts.
Haz clic en cualquier archivo para edita: Click any file to open it in the editor
Click any file to edit it
Scripts de KubeJS para modificar el comp: KubeJS scripts to change how the modpack behaves through code.
Descargar la carpeta kubejs/ como .zip: Download the kubejs/ folder as a .zip
Se añade .js si no tiene extensión: .js is added if there's no extension
Archivos de texto editables de cada mund: Editable text files of each world: statistics, advancements and datapacks. Binary files (level.dat, region/, playerdata) aren't shown.
Logs del servidor y crash reports. Los c: Server logs and crash reports. Crashes show the mod to blame when it can be identified.
Selecciona un archivo del panel izquierd: Select a file from the left panel
Arrastra un <strong>.jar</strong> o un <: Drop a .jar or a .zip with several mods here, or click to choose a file
Se verificará compatibilidad con la vers: Compatibility with the server version will be checked
Copias del mundo activo (con su Nether y: Backups of the active world (with its Nether and End). They can be made while the server is running: the panel pauses saving for a moment so the backup comes out whole. Automatic ones are set up in Automation.
Se copian los mods, la configuración y l: The mods, settings and scripts of are copied. Handy for trying changes without touching the good one.
Sin el mundo, la copia empezará con uno: Without the world, the copy will start with a new one the first time you run it.
Mínimo 8 caracteres, sin emojis. Las dem: At least 8 characters, no emojis. Other sessions open with this account will be logged out.
Dentro va una carpeta <code>mods/</code>: Inside there's a mods/ folder ready to copy. Disabled mods keep the .disabled extension, so the modloader will keep ignoring them.
Los mods marcados como «solo cliente» no: Mods marked as “client only” don't need to be in the server's mods/ folder — it's not an error that they're missing here, it's expected. Detection is based on metadata the mod itself declares, so “not detected” doesn't necessarily mean the server needs it.
Elige cuáles de los mods deshabilitados: Choose which disabled mods you really want to delete. This can't be undone.
¿Qué quieres incluir?: What do you want to include?
Lo que carga el servidor ahora mismo: What the server loads right now
Solo funciona si el modpack trae <code>u: Only works if the modpack includes user_jvm_args.txt or variables.txt.
Solo se modifican <code>-Xms</code> y <c: Only -Xms and -Xmx are changed. The rest of the file is left as it is.
Los «server files» del modpack, tal como: The modpack's “server files”, just as you download them from CurseForge or Modrinth.
Arrastra aquí el archivo o <span class=\: Drop the file here or choose it from your computer
Escribe el nombre de un modpack o elige: Type a modpack name or pick a category to get started.
Si se cae más veces en ese tiempo, se qu: If it crashes more times within that period, it stays stopped: something is wrong and it's worth checking the log. Stopping the server from the panel or with stop doesn't count as a crash.
Copiar el mundo mientras el servidor est: Back up the world while the server is running
Se hacen sin parar el servidor. Las copi: They're made without stopping the server. Backups you make by hand in Modpacks → Backups are never deleted automatically.
Solo letras, números, <code>_</code> y <: Only letters, numbers, _ and - · max. 16 characters
Como administrador puedes crear y elimin: As administrator you can create and delete users and change their password if they forget it. The administrator can't delete themselves; their own password is changed with the “Password” button in the menu.
Solo caracteres estándar (sin emojis) ·: Standard characters only (no emojis) · min. 8 characters
Credenciales y configuración específica: Credentials and settings specific to this installation. Changes don't apply live — when you save, you'll be offered to restart the app to apply them.
Números de ajuste (timeouts, límites, ta: Tuning numbers (timeouts, limits, cache sizes) shared by every installation — unlike .env, this file has no secrets and is tracked in git. Changes don't apply live — when you save, you'll be offered to restart the app to apply them.
El panel puede mandarte un mensaje cuand: The panel can message you when the server is ready, crashes or someone joins. It's optional and each installation uses its own bot: notifications only reach you. Changes apply immediately, without restarting.
En Telegram, abre <strong>@BotFather</st: In Telegram, open @BotFather, send it /newbot and pick a name. It will give you a token.
Abre tu bot nuevo, escríbele cualquier c: Open your new bot, send it anything (for example /start) and press Detect.
Mostrar u ocultar la API key: Show or hide the API key
Se rellena al pulsar Detectar: Filled in when you press Detect
En tu servidor de Discord: ajustes del c: In your Discord server: channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New Webhook → Copy Webhook URL.
Guardado (escribe otro para cambiarlo): Saved (type a new one to change it)
Se quitará al guardar: Will be removed when you save
Cada apartado se puede desplegar por sep: Each section can be expanded separately. If this is your first time using the app, start with “Create your first server”.
Desde la pestaña <b>Instalar</b> tienes: From the Install tab you have three ways to get a server, depending on what you already have:
<b>Subir un modpack</b>: si ya tienes un: Upload a modpack: if you already have a modpack downloaded (a .zip, for example exported from CurseForge/Modrinth, or a modpack's “server files”), upload it here and the app unpacks it and gets it ready.
<b>Crear desde cero</b>: arranca desde c: Create from scratch: start from nothing: you choose the Minecraft version, modloader (Forge, NeoForge, Fabric, Quilt or none) and its version, with no mods yet. Useful for modpacks without server files: you create the server with the right modloader and then add the mods by hand.
<b>Buscar y descargar</b>: busca un modp: Search and download: search for a modpack on Modrinth or CurseForge and the app takes care of everything: it downloads the modloader, the mods and the config. Before installing it checks whether that modpack looks like one you already have, so you don't duplicate it by mistake.
En los tres casos eliges también cuánta: In all three cases you also choose how much minimum/maximum RAM (-Xms/-Xmx) the server will have.
Elige un servidor arriba para ver sus pe: Choose a server at the top to see its tabs:
<b>Mods</b>: lista de mods instalados (a: Mods: list of installed mods (enable/disable/delete), upload single mods or a whole folder, and search for new mods online (with version compatibility checks and a warning if it's already installed). The “More options” menu also lets you view possible duplicates, view client-only mods and delete disabled mods in bulk.
<b>server.properties</b>: editor con for: server.properties: a form for the most common settings (difficulty, game mode, whitelist, MOTD…) or plain text for everything else.
<b>Config de mods</b>: edita los archivo: Mod config: edit each mod's config files (config/) from the browser.
<b>KubeJS</b>: si el modpack usa KubeJS,: KubeJS: if the modpack uses KubeJS, manage its scripts (create, edit, move/rename, delete).
<b>Archivos de mundo</b>: crea un mundo: World files: create a new world, switch the active one, or delete the ones you no longer use (except the active one).
<b>Logs</b>: consulta logs rotados y cra: Logs: browse rotated logs and crash reports; if there's a crash, the app tries to identify which mod caused it.
<b>Cambiar versión del modloader</b> (bo: Change modloader version (button in the Mods tab): upgrade or downgrade the modloader without touching mods or the world, warning you first if any mod would stop being compatible.
Desde la pestaña <b>Servidor</b> eliges: From the Server tab you choose which modpack to start (if there's more than one) and whether it accepts connections only from your local network or from any IP.
<b>Consola en vivo</b> — ves el log del: Live console — see the server log in real time and send commands (say, list, stop…) directly.
<b>Chat</b> — la pestaña <b>Chat</b> de: Chat — the console's Chat tab shows only player messages, who joins and leaves, and what's said with say. Whatever you type there reaches everyone as a server message.
<b>Métricas</b> — TPS y MSPT en vivo (ví: Metrics — live TPS and MSPT (over RCON, on Forge/NeoForge) and online players, while the server is running.
<b>Rendimiento</b> — gráficas de TPS, ju: Performance — charts of TPS, players and RAM over the last 24 hours or 7 days. One sample per minute is saved while the server is running; where it was off, the line breaks.
<b>Firewall</b> — controla si el puerto: Firewall — controls whether the Minecraft port is open only on your local network or from outside too (needs administrator permissions).
Gestión global de jugadores, aplicada a: Global player management, applied to every server at once: operators (ops), whitelist, and player or IP bans. If the server is running at that moment, use the console commands so the change takes effect right away (the files alone don't kick or admit anyone live).
Abajo, <b>Estadísticas</b> muestra lo qu: Below, Statistics shows what the world itself records for each player: time played, deaths, mobs, blocks mined, distance travelled… Click a column name to sort by it.
En <b>Modpacks → Copias</b> haces una co: In Modpacks → Backups you back up the world with one click (even with the server running: the panel pauses saving for a moment so the backup comes out whole), and download, restore or delete it. To restore, the server must be stopped, and a backup of the current world is saved first in case you want to go back.
El botón <b>Clonar</b> de un modpack cre: A modpack's Clone button creates an identical one (mods, settings, scripts and, if you want, the world) to try changes without touching the good one.
Todo funciona aunque no tengas el panel: Everything works even when the panel isn't open.
<b>Si el servidor se cae</b> — el panel: If the server crashes — the panel restarts it on its own, with a limit on attempts so it doesn't loop if something is wrong. Stopping from the panel or with stop doesn't count as a crash.
<b>Copias automáticas</b> — cada cierto: Automatic backups — every so many hours while the server is running, keeping only the latest ones.
<b>Tareas programadas</b> — reiniciar, p: Scheduled tasks — restart, stop or start a server, run a command or make a backup at a specific time and on specific days. Restarts and stops can warn players beforehand. Try runs it immediately so you can see it works.
Crea cuentas adicionales para otras pers: Create extra accounts for other people you want to be able to use the panel. Only the administrator can create or delete users, and they can't delete themselves.
Edita las variables de entorno (usuario,: Edit the environment variables (username, ports, domain, CurseForge key, auto-update…) and the app's internal tuning numbers (timeouts, limits, page sizes…) straight from the browser. Changes don't apply live: when you save, the panel offers to restart the app right away to apply them (it won't restart if a Minecraft server is running or an operation is in progress).
En <b>Avisos</b> configuras, si quieres,: In Notifications you can, if you want, have the panel message you on Telegram or Discord when the server is ready, crashes, someone joins… Each installation uses its own Telegram bot (you create it with @BotFather) or its own Discord webhook, so notifications only reach you. These changes do apply immediately.
Monitor de recursos del equipo donde cor: Resource monitor for the machine the app runs on: CPU, RAM and disk in real time, plus a check for app updates on GitHub.
